d:
Lord Melenas did not act alone; he was at the behest of another. The one you seek is Xethorr the Wicked. It seems he has twisted the spiders that call Teldrassil home, intending their venom for some foul plan.
He has taken residence deep in the forest, in the area to the northwest of here known as the Cleft. Take caution, and bring allies, for Xethorr is not an opponent to be trifled with.
Dispatch his brood, and bring me anything that may tell us more of the satyr's work here.
c:
I should have known this was being used to twist the spiders of this land.
I have heard whispers of this substance being the source of much of the corruption plaguing us. Though this is not the original, it is an older sample and may yield more information than what we have obtained so far.
Normally I would have you send this to Darnassus for further study. However, it is best we keep this quiet for the moment, or Dolanaar will never recover its reputation.
I trust you to do the same.

d:
In order to draw upon my spirit, you will need to undergo a trial. To understand and respect my form you must prove that you can embody cunning, stealth, and if you should be cornered, ferocity.
In the Barrow Dens just east of here, are three relics you must acquire. They are guarded by powerful enraged spirits that will attack you on sight. A statue at the entrance will bless you with temporary stealth to get past them.
Return these relics to me to pass the druidic trial of these lands.
p: Ah, you have returned. I do hope you have brought the relics with you?
c:
Excellent. You have shown you understand the true nature of the cat, and are able to embody the cunning, stealth, and ferocity needed to take my shape.
I now deem you worthy of my blessing, young adventurer.

d:
If the gnolls are growing so bold they are willing to camp this close to humans, there's no telling how much further they'll go. We need to deter them.
The beasts are hardly organized, but they seem to respect strength above all else. If we can slay the worst of them, maybe claim some of their trophies, we can remind these gnolls why they should stay in the hills where they belong.
Should you see any of their thrashers, bring me their collars. That should put the fear of the Alliance back into them.
p: A full assessment of the gnolls cannot be complete without facing the worst of their kind. Put those thrashers down!
c:
Quite the armful you have.
While this doesn't solve our problem out here, I can rest comfortably knowing we've discouraged them pushing any further. Great work, friend.

d: Inside of the vault you find a tablet detailing the terms of a peace treaty between the Bronzebeard and Wildhammer dwarf clans. It appears to date back to time period just after the War of the Three Hammers, and is very likely a notable piece of dwarven history. The king of Ironforge would no doubt be interested in this artifact.
p: What have you brought from the depths, adventurer.
c:
Ah yes, my ancestor Madoran was the first Bronzebeard king of Ironforge following the great civil war between the Wildhammer, Bronzebeard, and Dark Iron clans. This treaty was drafted to codify the cessation of hostilities and terms of peace after the Bronzebeards won the mountain.
As you can see, the Wildhammers and Bronzebeards signed it... And the Dark Irons did not.
Thank you for recovering this and bringing it to me, adventurer.

d:
Einige besonders abgenutzte Seiten stecken, sorgfältig gefaltet, in Fizsprockets Brusttasche.
Sie enthalten offenbar wichtige Informationen über die Venture Co. Und ihre Machenschaften in dieser Region. Bevor Ihr zu Morin Cloudstalker zurückkehrt, solltet Ihr nach den restlichen Seiten suchen.
c:
Ah. Das sind überaus wertvolle Informationen. Ich danke Euch für Eure Mühe.
Unser weiteres Vorgehen ist damit klar.

d:
Seid gegrüßt, adventurer. Was führt Euch an diesen Ort der Dunkelheit und Gewalt?
Häuptling Cairne Bloodhoof hat mich ursprünglich entsandt, um mit den Gnollen Kontakt aufzunehmen, die sich hier niedergelassen haben. Über den eigentlichen Auftrag darf ich jedoch nicht sprechen. So ist es bei den Langläufern, den Kundschaftern des Häuptlings.
Alles, was Ihr wissen müsst, ist dies: Unsere Friedensbemühungen wurden mit Gewalt erwidert. Wenn Ihr mir nicht helft zu entkommen, werde ich den Gnollen heute Nacht wohl als Mahl dienen.
Werdet Ihr mir helfen?
c:
Ich bin erleichtert, dass Langläufer Stormhoof wohlauf ist. Er ist mein vertrauenswürdigster Kundschafter, und seine Mission ist von größter Bedeutung.
Bitte nehmt meinen Dank und meine Gastfreundschaft dafür an, dass Ihr Euer Leben riskiert habt, um das seine zu retten. Ihr habt unserem Volk einen größeren Dienst erwiesen, als Euch bewusst ist.
Ich hoffe, Ihr nutzt die Gelegenheit, unsere schöne Stadt zu erkunden. Hier seid Ihr sicher, und auf ihren Anhöhen werdet Ihr vielen begegnen, die Euch auf Euren eigenen Reisen weiterhelfen können.
Ish-ne-alo por-ah.

d:
Unsere Ältesten in Thunder Bluff müssen erfahren, welche Fortschritte wir dank Eurer Hilfe erzielt haben.
Bitte bringt diesen Bericht zu Erzdruide Hamuul Runentotem in Thunder Bluff. Ihr findet ihn auf der Anhöhe der Ältesten im Osten der Stadt. Nehmt den Aufzug hinauf ins Zentrum der Stadt und überquert anschließend die Brücken.
c:
Ah. Kein Wunder, dass die Bäche Mulgors heute so fröhlich plätschern. Ihr habt der Welt einen großen Dienst erwiesen. Die Quellen versorgen nicht nur uns. Auch die Tiere, von denen wir Nahrung, Kleidung und Freundschaft erhalten, sind auf sie angewiesen.
Es ist mir eine Freude, Mulls Bitte zu erfüllen. Bitte nehmt dieses Zeichen meiner Dankbarkeit an.

d:
Bart Tidewater's a no-good cheapskate, I tell ya!
"Captain of the Maiden's Virtue" he calls himself. That ship's sailed as far as a rock in Tanaris! He's no captain, he's an actor who won enough hands of poker to buy the Virtue in the first place!
If you ever find yourself in Menethil Harbor over in the Wetlands, give this to him and let him know it's from ol' Half-fish.
There's a boat from here that can take you right to the harbor, by the way. It'll be the second stop!
And he cheats at poker!
p:
Put yer backs into it! We set sail on my word!
Oh? What's that you have there, traveler?
c:
Why that no good, son of a--
Did he even tell you that HE is the one who cheats at poker?! I only won enough money to buy the Maiden's Virtue after we kicked him out of our poker circle!
I swear, the next time I see that absolute waste of seawater--
I'm sorry, I'm sorry. I shouldn't shoot the messenger. On behalf of the crew of the Maiden's Virtue--finest ship in the Great Sea--welcome to Menethil Harbor!

d:
If you're heading out of Auberdine, I could use your help!
My dear friend Tarrel and I were classmates in school. Oh, he was such a quickfire on all things excavation! We got split up after graduation--him to Wetlands, and me to here in Darkshore.
Sorry, and his wife... Merrin.
It doesn't matter. If you go to the Wetlands, could you make sure he's alright? And maybe give him this? He's probably near Menethil Harbor. There's a boat straight there.
c:
Oh... Oh my. Poor Hollee.
She always did have a bit of a thing for me. And, truth be told, there was a time where I would have reciprocated. But I'm married. Happily married!
I think the best thing to do here is not to reply. I don't know how to let her down, and I have far more pressing things to worry about here! My wife is missing!

d:
Look, I'm glad to have you at my bar, and that's exactly why I'm telling you this.
The real party? That's over at the Salty Sailor Tavern in Booty Bay. Yes, in Stranglethorn Vale--that Booty Bay.
Don't give me that look. I know it's run by goblins. Bartenders talk, and bar patrons talk a LOT. All I'm saying is that if you want to see things get real wild, head over there.
Nixxrax Fillamug will keep you topped up, don't even worry.
